_tier: Ultra — high-end dedicated box, thousands of concurrent users.
__usage: Fill in SERVER_SPOOF_IP / CLIENT_REAL_IP / CLIENT_SPOOF_IP / keys, then run: quiccochet -c ultra-server.json
___tuning: tun.queues and quic.pool_size below assume an 8-core box — set both to your actual core count. performance.pacing_rate_mbps should sit slightly below this server's real uplink capacity (e.g. 900 for a 1 Gbps NIC) once you know it; 0 leaves pacing disabled.
